data.one_liner: An abstraction for two-way communication channels based on the Dart Stream class.
data.what_it_does: Exposes the StreamChannel interface representing a two-way communication channel, exposing a Stream for receiving and a StreamSink for sending data. It helps abstract communication logic away from underlying protocols and provides utilities for managing two-way communications.
use_when: You need to abstract two-way communication protocols away from your core logic.
You are building or testing systems using WebSocket or Isolate connections.
avoid_when: You do not need a standardized Stream and StreamSink abstraction for bi-directional communication.
strengths: Clean abstraction for two-way communication channels based on standard Dart Streams.
Includes helpful utilities and transformers for dealing with stream channels.
weaknesses: Limited to what is supported by standard Dart Streams and Sinks.
